tr: Hi, this is Dana Lewis from Northfield Dental. I ordered two boxes of printer paper and some toner from your Web site on Monday, but the delivery hasn't arrived yet.
Let me check, Ms. Lewis. Hmm, it looks like the toner you ordered is on back order, so the entire shipment is being held at our warehouse.
Oh, I see. We're almost out of paper, though, and we need it for patient forms.
I understand. I can send the paper today, and the toner will follow next week. And since it's our mistake, I'll take care of the delivery charge.
Good morning. I'm here for the Regional Retail Conference. I registered online, and I'd like to pick up my badge.
Certainly. Registration is at the table to your left, but it doesn't open until nine. Are you staying at the hotel with us?
Yes, but my room won't be ready until this afternoon. Is there somewhere I can leave my suitcase? I don't want to carry it into the first session.
Of course. Just give it to the bellhop by the elevators, and he'll give you a claim ticket. Your bag will be delivered to your room when it's ready.
Marcus, Tom, thanks for coming in early. As you know, the health inspector is visiting the restaurant on Thursday.
Right. I've already deep-cleaned the kitchen, but the walk-in refrigerator is still running a little warm.
I called the repair company about that yesterday. They can't send anyone until Friday.
That's too late. Tom, try calling Coastal Refrigeration instead. They fixed the freezer last spring, and they were fast.
Will do. If they can come on Wednesday, I'll stay late to let them in.
And I'll move the meat and dairy to the small refrigerator until it's fixed.
Hi, I have a reservation for a compact car under the name Yusuf Demir. I'd like to pick it up now.
Yes, Mr. Demir. I'm afraid we don't have any compact cars left today, but I can upgrade you to a midsize sedan at no additional charge.
That's fine, as long as it has a navigation system. I'm driving to Lakeview for a client visit, and I've never been there.
All our midsize cars include one. I just need to see your driver's license and a credit card. You can return the car to any of our locations.
Hi, Ravi. It's your first week here, so I wanted to see how everything's going. Do you have everything you need?
Mostly, yes. But I still can't get into the shared drive where the client files are stored. The system keeps saying I don't have permission.
That's probably because your supervisor has to approve it. Have you filled out the access form?
No. I wasn't aware there was one.
It's on the company intranet, under "Forms." Once Ms. Cho signs it, the technology department usually sets it up within a day.
Thanks. I'll do that right after lunch.
Hello, Ms. Whitfield? This is Owen from Page Turner Books. We're all very excited about your book signing on Saturday.
So am I. I just wanted to confirm that it starts at two o'clock.
That's right. But I do have a question for you. We've already sold over a hundred advance tickets.
Wow. I expected about thirty people.
So did we. Our store can't seat that many, so we've asked the community center next door to host the event instead. Would that be acceptable?
Of course. And could you ask them to put a table near the entrance? My publisher is sending extra copies.
Kevin, the movers are coming on the twenty-first to take everything to the new office. Are the sales team's files packed?
Almost. But we have a problem. The landlord at the new building just told me the carpet won't be installed until the twenty-fifth.
That's four days after we move in. We can't put furniture on a floor that's going to be covered.
I know. I spoke with the moving company, and they can change the date to the twenty-sixth, but there's a small fee.
It's worth paying. Please go ahead and reschedule it. I'll let the staff know they can work from home on the twenty-first.
Hi, I've been a member of this fitness center for a year, and my membership is about to expire. What are my renewal options?
You can renew for six months or twelve months. The twelve-month plan is a better value, and this month it includes two free sessions with a personal trainer.
That sounds good, but I'm being transferred overseas next spring.
In that case, you might want the six-month plan. But if you do choose the annual one, you can cancel with thirty days' notice as long as you show proof of your move.
Oh, that's good to know. Do you have that information in writing?
Thanks for meeting with us, Paul. Lena and I have the sample packaging for our new line of herbal teas.
We've used recycled cardboard for the box, as you requested. What do you think?
I like the material, but the brand name is hard to see from a distance. Customers walking past a shelf might miss it.
We could make the letters larger and change them from green to white.
That would be easy. We could have a revised sample by Tuesday.
Good. I'd like to show it to our sales director on Wednesday. If she approves it, we can start production by the end of the month.
Excuse me. My train to Bristol was canceled this morning, so I took the bus instead. I'd like to get a refund for my ticket.
I'm sorry about that. The signal problem affected all the morning trains. Do you still have your ticket?
It's on my phone. Here. I bought it through your app.
Ah, app purchases can't be refunded here at the station.
But I've come all the way across town.
I know, and I'm sorry. It takes only a minute, though. Just open the app, tap "My Trips," and choose "Request Refund." The money usually goes back to your card within three days.
Hi, Sofia. Are you ready for the client presentation on Thursday?
Nearly. I've reserved Conference Room B for the afternoon, right after Human Resources. But the client called and asked if we could start earlier, at one o'clock.
That might be possible. Human Resources is just doing interviews, so they could use a smaller room. Let me ask them to switch with you.
Thanks. Could you also check that the projector in Room B is working? It was making a strange noise last week.
Sure. I'll ask someone from technical support to look at it tomorrow.

We also want to remind you about our one-day sale tomorrow. All fresh fruit and vegetables will be twenty percent off. And for those of you who've joined our rewards program, you'll receive an additional five percent off your total purchase. If you aren't a member yet, you can sign up at the customer service desk. It takes only a few minutes. Thank you for shopping at Greenway Market.

Welcome to Harbor Point Lighthouse, everyone. I'm Elena, and I'll be your guide this morning. This lighthouse was built in 1872, and it guided ships into the harbor for more than a hundred years. In a moment, we'll climb the 142 steps to the top, where you'll have a wonderful view of the coast. I should mention that the stairs are narrow, so please hold on to the handrail. Also, the stairs are too narrow for bags, so please leave any backpacks here in the lockers. After the tour, feel free to visit our gift shop, where you can buy prints of the old lighthouse.

Before we finish, I'd like to update you on the mobile app project. The design is complete, and testing begins on Monday. We're asking twenty employees to try the app for two weeks and report any problems. Now, I know that everyone is busy with the end-of-year sales. Work crews are repairing the Mill River Bridge, and only one lane is open in each direction. The work is scheduled to continue through Friday. City officials are advising drivers to take Oak Street instead, or to use the commuter rail, which has added two extra trains during rush hour this week. We'll be back with another update after this message from our sponsor, Blue Sky Coffee.

Hi, Andre. It's Naomi from the design team. I'm looking at the brochure you sent, and it looks great overall. There's just one thing. The photo on page three shows last year's model of the blender, not the new one. I've attached the right image to my e-mail. The printer needs the final version by three o'clock today. I've got a client meeting until two. Could you make the change and send it directly to the printer? Then just copy me on the e-mail, and I'll look at it when I get back. Thanks.

Good afternoon, everyone, and welcome to your first shift at Keystone Distribution. Before you go out onto the warehouse floor, you need to pick up your safety equipment. Helmets and vests are in the bins behind me. Please choose your size and write your name on the label. Now, each of you has been paired with an experienced worker, who'll show you how to use the handheld scanners. By the way, the break room has been moved to the second floor while the first floor is being painted. Lunch is at noon.

Thank you all for coming to the Westbrook Business Awards. Tonight we honor the Entrepreneur of the Year, Grace Mwangi. Six years ago, Ms. Mwangi opened a small bicycle repair shop. Today, GreenWheel has eleven stores across the region, and it's created more than two hundred jobs. What sets her apart, though, is her commitment to the community. Each summer, GreenWheel gives free bicycles to local students. Ms. Mwangi will say a few words in a moment. But first, let's watch a short video about the company's early days.

Good evening, passengers on Flight 318 to Vancouver. We apologize for the delay. The aircraft arrived late because of strong winds in Chicago. We'll begin boarding in about ten minutes. Passengers with small children and those in need of assistance may board first. Then we'll board from the back of the plane, starting with passengers in rows thirty-one to forty. Because the flight is full, there won't be enough room overhead for all carry-on bags. If you'd like to check your bag free of charge, please see the agent at the gate.
